# GitHub Copilot instructions

- Follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) and the repository's existing patterns.
- Keep portable skills and shared tool contracts vendor-neutral.
- Put vendor-specific commands, hooks, agents, permissions, and packaging in an
  explicit vendor adapter.
- Add or update tests for changed scripts and packaging behavior.
- Follow the repository's
  [public-safe guidance](../docs/public-safe-summary.md) and linked internal
  standards rather than duplicating organization policy here.
- Record durable compatibility, source-custody, and portability findings in the
  [engineering journal](../docs/engineering-journal/README.md).
